newsitem.title: USA: Famous Dave's Q1 costs expands loss.
newsitem.headline: Famous Dave's Q1 costs expands loss.

text.p: Famous Dave's of America Inc said Thursday higher expenses linked to its growth plan contributed to wider losses in the first quarter ended March 30.

The company posted a net loss of $619,287, or $0.10 a share, versus a loss of $250,448, or $0.11, in the same period last year. Sales increased to $2.2 million from $290,388 in the first quarter a year ago.

Famous Dave's said its general, administrative and development expenses increased significantly in the most recent period. The company is also accelerating its plans for area development agreements across the country and preparing for a national expansion of its restaurant concept.
Famous Dave's operates four barbecue restaurants and expects to open four more locations by the end of the third quarter. Its shares were up 1/8 Thursday at 10-1/8.
